headline: Asian Policy Decisions Drive Growth of Projected $15 Trillion Energy Market
summary: Asian governments are positioning the region as a pivotal $15 trillion energy transition market, shaping global consumption trajectories across coal, oil, gas, renewables, and storage.
why: Asia accounts for the majority of global energy demand growth, determining the capital requirements and supply-demand balance of traditional commodities and clean technology.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Trillions in Asian energy infrastructure investment accelerate project financing for renewables, grid stability, and storage.
